Hi Jane (and Acme security team),

Thanks for the request — happy to coordinate. We can provide either the completed SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026 period (if finalized) or a bridge letter plus a small evidence bundle if the report is still in circulation with our auditor. Below are the options and what each contains, plus secure-transfer instructions.

Option A — Final Type II report (preferred)
- PDF of the full report (redactions limited to customer-identifying data on sample evidence)
- Management assertion (CEO or Head of Security signature)

Option B — Bridge letter + minimal bundle (if report not yet issued)
- Bridge letter (explains audit window and expected report delivery date)
- Control summary (1–2 page mapping for logical access, change control, incident response, availability)
- Signed management assertion
- High-level system diagram and retention policy excerpt

Minimal evidence guidance (what we typically share):
- Control descriptions and owner list
- Policy excerpts (access control, incident response, change mgmt)
- Redacted sample logs or telemetry (PII removed) — we redact raw user data; provide aggregated/annotated excerpts instead
- Incident log (redacted) for the audit period if relevant

Secure transfer options:
- Recommended: temporary SFTP account (we can provision a customer-scoped path) — request by reply and we will send creds via separate email
- Box/ShareFile link with password and view-only settings
- If you prefer a signed NDAs/transfer agreement, we can sign — but we typically use the SFTP route for audit artifacts

Attached: Initial_Soc2_Intake_Checklist.pdf (short checklist you can complete), Bridge_Letter_Template.docx, Secure_Share_Instructions.txt

Sample reply you can send back to us quickly:
"Hi Logan — thanks. Please provision SFTP and we'll upload the completed intake form by 2027-03-04. Contact for upload: jane.doe@acmecorp.com."

If you confirm Option B, please indicate which artifacts you need first (management assertion + control summary are the most common). We can also provide a short bridge letter draft for your records and flag the expected report delivery window (typically ~6–8 weeks after auditor sign-off).

Best,

--
Logan Wright
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report intake — internal redaction and evidence notes

Logan / Monica — internal quick note for the thread (do not forward raw logs):
- Redaction guidance: never include raw PII or full email bodies. Provide redacted snippets or aggregated telemetry with timestamps and control IDs.
- Logs: supply 2–3 short, annotated excerpts and a provenance statement describing log retention and rotation.
- Request management assertion signed by Head of Security or CEO (PDF).
- Prefer SFTP (less manual) — when provisioning, create a single-use path with write-only permission for the external account and 30-day expiry.
- If they request a SOC2 bridge that references specific controls, include the control mapping doc we keep in /compliance/control-matrix (we'll export a one-page summary).

I'll draft the bridge letter language if they ask — keep it conservative on timelines (e.g., "final report expected by 2027-04-15, subject to auditor completion").

Kim
